description: Get the base every NEW project starts from — the host shell with sign-in and the lobby (index.html, main.tsx, src/app.config.ts, the wallet files, empty src/modules.ts, config; the lobby and sign-in come from @idosgames/app-shell). Write these to the project root, then add modules with get_module: the systems with inBase (profile, inventory, invite, friends, quests, mailbox), the game(s) with the modules each game 'uses', and any other system the app needs.
